arguments.content:
#!/bin/bash
# Step 1: find Tara Reyes's user id
curl -s -X POST https://slack.com/api/users.list -H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>" --data-urlencode "token=<TOKEN>" > /tmp/users.json
# Step 2: find #field-trip channel id
curl -s -X POST https://slack.com/api/conversations.list -H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>" --data-urlencode "token=<TOKEN>" --data-urlencode "types=public_channel,private_channel" --data-urlencode "limit=1000" > /tmp/channels.json
python3 - <<'EOF'
import json
users = json.load(open('/tmp/users.json'))
channels = json.load(open('/tmp/channels.json'))
print('users ok:', users.get('ok'), '| err:', users.get('error'))
print('channels ok:', channels.get('ok'), '| err:', channels.get('error'))
for u in users.get('members', []):
    if u.get('is_bot') or u.get('deleted'):
        continue
    rn = (u.get('profile') or {}).get('real_name', '') or ''
    un = u.get('username') or ''
    if 'tara' in rn.lower() or 'reyes' in rn.lower() or 'tara' in un.lower():
        print('USER:', u['id'], '|', un, '|', rn)
for c in channels.get('channels', []):
    n = c.get('name', '')
    if n.replace('_', '-') == 'field-trip':
        print('CHANNEL:', c['id'], '|', n, '| private:', c.get('is_private'))
EOF
